objects.summary: October-era agent contract routes first through North Star/current project state/live HEAD, separates authority from tests/audits, preserves negative memory and distinguishes research/portfolio/control roles. It already treats branch sprawl as a defect and asks for durable exact-head reporting, but still reflects an intermediate topology where V2 canonical trunk was undeclared.

September whole-system contract establishes economic relevance first, SCAN→VET→SIZE→RISK→FILLS→BOOK, persistent state, IDLE!=FINISHED and autonomous continuation after ordinary research failures. It routes through Blue governance/handoffs and explicitly warns that STATE/CHIEF_BRIEF/default branch are not current authority.

Revision of the September contract adds repository-hygiene and branch-authority routing documents plus an updated reacquisition map. Core economic/scientific laws are essentially unchanged, showing routing/governance churn around a stable operating objective.

Later Blue-oriented revision makes a compact F11 reacquisition handoff the first operational route while retaining the same whole-system roles, objective hierarchy and autonomous research loop. Repeated byte presence across many owner-recovery snapshots shows this contract family was semantically shared across divergent rails.

Build-plane-oriented version introduces BUILDER_ROLE as provider-independent authority and explicitly forbids Builder self-certification, protocol changes and capital authority. It improves separation of construction from verification while preserving the same whole-system North Star.

Long autonomous-quant-research contract centered on OBJECTIVE.md: broad market search, mechanism/payor/persistence reasoning, preregistration, independent judge, PIT/data discipline, OOS/cost/factor attribution, value-of-information ranking, alpha-decay lifecycle and explicit live-capital boundary. Strong scientific/economic doctrine; its length also illustrates governance expansion that later contracts compressed.

Simpler autonomous-research contract: continuous SCAN→FILTER→HYPOTHESIZE→TEST→VALIDATE→PAPER/SHADOW→LEARN loop, stateful research memory and limited human escalation. It captures the economic-search objective cleanly without later governance detail.

Earlier OBJECTIVE-based research contract emphasizes reproducibility, anti-overfitting, holdout consumption, costs, baselines, value-of-information and complexity discipline. It is narrower on durable routing/authority but already states the core principle that implementation may change while success may not be redefined.

Another September routing revision replaces the reacquisition pointer while retaining nearly identical economic/system rules. Evidence of repeated operational-router editing rather than repeated redefinition of the project objective.

Earlier whole-system contract with minimal routing list and the same core roles, economic hierarchy, autonomous research, persistent state and anti-plumbing objective. Useful baseline showing that many later governance additions refined routing/authority rather than inventing the North Star.

July 25 audit correctly identifies material calc_mdd and fractional-differencing implementation bugs plus multiple lookahead/walk-forward violations, and applies targeted fixes. However it also labels A–D production-ready, proposes deleting many historical outputs and ends with an unsupported 70% success estimate before all reruns/validation TODOs are complete. Valuable bug forensics mixed with premature cleanup/promotion confidence.

July 26 closure correctly exposes major lookahead artifacts in S5-OV/ML, but then over-promotes Phase-D volatility overlay to deployment-ready, prescribes paper/live deployment and describes a cleanup package as watertight. Later forensic evidence supersedes this authority. Key example of real defect discovery followed by premature promotion from backtest/audit evidence to deployment readiness.

July audit documents severe multiple-testing/validation problems and initially rejects the 5.069 Sharpe claim, then a favorable holdout result causes a revised narrative suggesting 3.3–5.3 Sharpe and meaningful ML value despite acknowledged search contamination and correlated validation. This internal re-promotion illustrates why later scientific memory, family-level multiplicity and consumed-holdout rules became necessary.

Provider-independent Build Plane contract cleanly separates Blue objective/mission authority, Builder implementation, Red-Team certification and runtime state. It states narration/local results are not evidence, unpushed work is not project truth, requires preflight/adversarial proof/exact-head handoff, and limits human escalation to genuine boundaries. Strong direct correction to historical self-certification and local-only work loss.

October 20 near-closure map says major planes already exist and remaining work is proof/absorption/canonicalization: real V2→Live Lab E2E, V2 reboot recovery, historical capability/scientific-memory reconciliation, then canonical trunk consolidation. It explicitly says near closure is not canonical closure and forbids rebuilding V2/Capital Desk, opening outcomes or destructive cleanup while evidence remains incomplete.

Generated persistent-state projection with two datasets, three blocked research lanes, one rejected execution-aware relative-value strategy, empty authoritative paper book and evaluation-book losses. It is useful factual state output but explicitly generated/supporting, not governance authority.

Expanded generated brief with six datasets and SEC capture lane blocked on identity/contact, while research remains blocked and the same relative-value strategy stays rejected. Shows state capability/data expansion without implying new economic edge or authority.

Two-dataset generated brief essentially matches the earlier research/capital state and blockers. Repeated projection content across versions reinforces that CHIEF_BRIEF is a regenerable state view, not an authority surface.

Four-dataset generated brief adds futures datasets and SEC-capture status while preserving the same blocked research frontier and rejected relative-value result. State growth is real but does not equal research progress or runtime promotion.

Later generated brief records boots=2/ticks=385 and a slightly changed evaluation ledger/fill count including one blocked ticket, while core research blockers and authoritative paper book remain unchanged. Demonstrates why generated projections must be bound to generation time/state rather than treated as timeless truth.

cross_object_findings.finding: Multiple AGENTS.md revisions materially change routing, handoffs and authority surfaces while preserving the same core economic objective, research autonomy, state persistence and capital boundary. A substantial part of historical document churn was governance/routing refinement around a comparatively stable North Star.

The July audit documents found genuine lookahead, MDD and frac-diff defects, but then repeatedly promoted surviving components to production/deployment or re-promoted ML after favorable holdout evidence before multiplicity/holdout contamination was fully resolved. Deep forensic conclusions must preserve the useful bug findings while superseding the deployment claims.

BUILDER_ROLE formalizes later-learned distinctions: Builder cannot define objective and certify itself, local/unpushed output is not project truth, exact-head proof and Red-Team handoff are required. This directly addresses repeated historical failure modes.

CHIEF_BRIEF versions change dataset counts, SEC state, boot/tick counts and evaluation-ledger values while preserving core blockers. They are useful generated projections but must never be used as timeless governance/runtime authority without freshness binding.

CP14 correctly separated architectural near-completeness from remaining E2E, reboot, semantic-reconciliation and canonicalization work. Later work should not reinterpret its near-closure statement as deployment/runtime proof.
Bundle 0002 deepens causal understanding of governance evolution and premature historical promotion but does not reveal a new current canonical code/runtime repair requirement.
